title: Observed vs. Simulated Long-Period Ground Motions in the Los Angeles Basin
subtitle: Chapter 1
description: Compares recorded long-period ground motions with 3D numerical simulations to evaluate how well current community velocity models capture basin amplification and duration across Greater Los Angeles.

title: 3D Waveform Tomography of the Greater Los Angeles Region
subtitle: Chapter 2
description: Uses full-waveform inversion to refine the seismic velocity structure beneath Southern California's sedimentary basins, in collaboration with the Southern California Earthquake Center (SCEC).

title: Frequency-Dependent Wave Amplification from Dense Nodal Arrays
subtitle: Chapter 3
description: Analyzes polarization and amplification of seismic waves recorded by dense nodal deployments to connect complex subsurface structure with site-specific ground shaking.

title: Seismic Imaging Across the Nepal Himalaya
subtitle: Chapter 4
description: Extends multiscale modeling and imaging techniques to the Himalayan collision zone, characterizing crustal structure in one of the world's most seismically active mountain belts.
